results.evidence_text: The group of cases consisted of 90 men histologically diagnosed with prostatic cancer in the 'La Paz' hospital (Madrid) during the 4-year period of 1983-1987. The controls were 180 men
results.one_sentence_explanation: The abstract reports 90 cases and 180 controls in a single case-control analysis of dietary factors including vitamin A, totaling 270 participants, which supports the Claude+Gemini value of 270 over ChatGPT's null.
